name: example-hyperframes-only
description: Pure HyperFrames: an HTML composition rendered locally and on Cloudflare Containers, split into chunks over instances (HyperFrames' distributed renderer) or in one piece (the hyperframes CLI).

scripts.check: cd composition && hyperframes check && cd ../long && hyperframes check
scripts.local: npm run assets && HYPERFRAMES_PROJECTS_DIR=. HYPERFRAMES_CLI_DIR=. node ../../packages/core/bin/render.mjs local --engine=../../packages/hyperframes-engine/engine.ts --render='{"project":"composition","quality":"draft"}' --out=out/local.mp4
scripts.local:cli: npm run assets && HYPERFRAMES_PROJECTS_DIR=. HYPERFRAMES_CLI_DIR=. node ../../packages/core/bin/render.mjs local --engine=../../packages/hyperframes-engine/engine.ts --render='{"project":"composition","quality":"draft","split":false}' --out=out/local-cli.mp4
scripts.local:long: npm run assets && HYPERFRAMES_PROJECTS_DIR=. HYPERFRAMES_CLI_DIR=. node ../../packages/core/bin/render.mjs local --engine=../../packages/hyperframes-engine/engine.ts --render='{"project":"long","quality":"draft"}' --chunks auto --instances 2 --processes-per-instance 2 --out=out/long.mp4
scripts.compare: npm run assets && HYPERFRAMES_PROJECTS_DIR=. HYPERFRAMES_CLI_DIR=. node ../../packages/core/bin/with-typescript-run.mjs ../../packages/hyperframes-engine/test/compare-split.ts --project composition --chunks 3
scripts.compare:long: npm run assets && HYPERFRAMES_PROJECTS_DIR=. HYPERFRAMES_CLI_DIR=. node ../../packages/core/bin/with-typescript-run.mjs ../../packages/hyperframes-engine/test/compare-split.ts --project long --chunks 4 --flash 120,964,56 --min-ssim 0.98
scripts.docker:build: npm run assets && docker build --platform linux/amd64 -f Dockerfile -t rrh-hyperframes-only ../..
